exact_structural_finding: rho_KG is invariant under a three-parameter torus T of local diagonal unitaries (Alice phases theta0, theta0+delta, theta0+2delta, theta3; Bob phases phi0, phi0-delta, phi0-2delta, theta0+phi0+2delta-theta3, theta0+phi0-2delta-theta3), whose weight decomposition of C^4 (x) C^5 has blocks {00,11,22}, {01,12}, {02,34}, {10,21}, {20,33} and nine singletons. Hence its separators may be T-twirled without loss: the witness problem for rho_KG lives in a 34-real-parameter family. Derived by hand from the eigenvector conditions of its nine range vectors; floating-point check confirms rho_KG lies in that family with zero residual.
exploratory_only_not_a_result: Fully corrective Frank-Wolfe in the 34-dimensional T-invariant sector converged (f=1.38e-7 with duality gap 2.4e-9) to a Hilbert-Schmidt distance about 5.3e-4 from the normalized rho_KG to SN_2, and to a near-optimal separator W (numerical SR2 minimum -3e-10, Tr(W rho_n)=-2.7e-7).

For that W the 25x25 link operator of Theorem 1 has exactly one negative eigenvalue (-5.5e-8; next +4.0e-6); its eigenvector is a nearly maximally entangled 5x5 matrix (singular values 0.446-0.449), and a 40-start local minimization over all rank-4 Bob filters found a positive minimum (+1.7e-6). This matches the bridge's rigidity prediction Corollary 4(a)-(c) and gives no 4x4 candidate; it is consistent with, not evidence for, N4 failing.

An exact modular (p=2147483629) degree-4/5 ideal-membership search over 11264 grid-type 4x4 ranges built from the Krebs-Gachechiladze core found 40 ranges satisfying the range criterion exactly mod p, but penalty descent found none of them compatible with a PPT operator carrying psi00 weight (minimal partial-transpose eigenvalue about -0.012 at weight 0.05). Proper-family numerical screen only.
blocker: The separating margin of rho_KG is tiny (distance ~5e-4, violation ~3e-7), so exact certification of a detecting 2-positive map by gridding or interval bounds is infeasible; the range criterion yields no linear witness. N4 remains UNKNOWN.
